attributes.title: Lists
attributes.lede: One name, two lists, one move.

lesson.concept: A transfer also reshapes its surroundings
lesson.why: A counterpart match carries the moved name across lists while the containing columns resize on the same spring. The choreography expresses the transfer and its effects as one pass.
lesson.experiment: Transfer a name, then move another before the first lands. Follow the arriving name and both column boundaries.
lesson.pitfall: Animating the flyer alone leaves the rest of the interface jumping abruptly around it.
lesson.combine: Combine with inbox beacons for actions whose endpoints are outside either list.
